description: Indicators the extractor currently promotes on real-report labels although the publisher does not assert them (recorded, NOT accepted). A fix removes its entries; realReports.test.js fails on any FP not listed here and on a listed FP that no longer occurs. Diagnosed on tl-candidates-v25 / tl-zones-v9 (2026-10-15).

causes.unlabelled_list_discovery: documentZones.applyObservableListZones turns a run of observable-only body rows into explicit_ioc_section (MODE A authority) without a publisher heading and without reading the lead-in sentence; here the advisory names the services as legitimate ones to review traffic to.
causes.body_table_header_discovery: A body table whose header looks like an IOC table (looksLikeIocTableHeader) becomes explicit_ioc_section outside the publisher's headed IOC section; columns that are lookup attributes (resolution IPs) or triaged look-alike samples become Indicators.
causes.bare_url_prefix_in_ioc_block: A bare URL prefix line inside the publisher IOC pre block is kept as a URL Indicator.
